core_order: One seeded random permutation of remaining eligible members for each fixed draw. Every n uses its first n-m members. n changes membership and composition as well as vote threshold; not pure causal effect of head count.
draw_allocation: All cells one draw; R two distinct unordered(A,B),C block partitions when possible; remaining budget goes to G second draws by salted-hash round-robin strata (m,historical phase,building,difficulty). Feasible source vectors in salted-hash order, draws cycle vectors. Identity samples seeded, reject duplicate block partition. No result is read.
integer_coverage: All m=1..sum(source capacities); all n=max(2,m)..N-2m. Two-person and other non-evaluable attempts retained.
interpretation: Previously selected G and R directions, reused and repeatedly explored v2. All these non-history buildings are assessment strata, not new external blind images or people. History10 features/labels frozen unchanged.
omissions: All exact member sets are not enumerated: one or two block draws per pool,m only.
Not all feasible source allocations are sampled if more than the allocated draws.
No enriched core order under this request budget; random-order nested chains only.
Unknown reverse-label workers are excluded from class experiments, not assigned a low class.
No doorways/Semi/special pools in this known global ordinary-Manual baseline; those belong to separate condition studies.

prespecified_sensitivities.Q: Overall utility first; then historical block Q(C)-Q(B) continuous linear adjustment plus |gap|<=2 support subset. Historical q_beta only, no target-building Q feature. This does not identify independent causal class effects when class and people confound.
prespecified_sensitivities.core_proportions: core incoming-class fraction bins [0,.25),[.25,.5),[.5,.75),[.75,1], plus empty core separately; total replacement fraction m/n; report support.
prespecified_sensitivities.low_tail: Signed C-B quality p10 and finite negative/positive counts; complete/evaluable and failure states for every arm; no zero imputation.
prespecified_sensitivities.person: Leave each actual worker out of all events containing them, and separately leave each block worker out; report remaining buildings/images/events, not a new intervention.
prespecified_sensitivities.source: A/B/C exact source-count match; separate all-new/all-v1/mixed blocks and source proportions where feasible.
prespecified_sensitivities.threshold: Adjacent fixed-block nested-core steps; ceil(n/2) and added-member identity/class/source recorded. Node supports are observation identities, not necessary-structure semantics.

primary_analysis: All attempted events: within A-B versus cross A-C, and signed C-B B8L2/D10; stable flags use failures=False, continuous missing stays null. Equal weight draws within image, images within building, buildings within stratum. Every target,n,m; source-vector and historical-phase/difficulty/core-proportion conditions retained.
shape_selection: Metadata only: n_min/n_max, n in {2m-1,2m,2m+1}, and event salted hash modulo 11 equals 0. Every selected event computes both A-B and A-C new metrics. Other events retain all original strict/main/wide and no-Q criteria. Adjacent n geometry diagnostics are allowed only when both endpoints are in the registered subset.
source_capacity: For each source s, outgoing A and B each require v_s, incoming C requires v_s; v_s<=min(floor(out_s/2),in_s), sum(v_s)=m. Blocks A,B,C disjoint, common core excludes all three.
